verdict.rationale: Stable documents registrable webhook endpoints, configured in the dashboard, that notify you about account events. Pricing and product pages confirm "API and webhooks," and the mail item object exposes a scan status of processing or completed. However, the pack never names a new-mail-arrived or scan-completed webhook event; the only specific webhook use documented is onboarding progress. Slack and email alerts are chat or email notifications, not webhooks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented new-mail and scan-complete event types, a webhook payload/event catalog, Zapier triggers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get webhooks (or at least Zapier triggers) when new mail arrives or a scan completes, so downstream automation starts without polling

citations.quote: You can configure webhook endpoints via the Stable Dashboard. We use webhooks to notify you about important events that happen with your account.
Automate manual workflows and data extraction with our API, webhooks, and native integrations.
Monitor the onboarding progress via webhooks
